capabilityRows.Frontend Impact: Use modular route ownership and feature folders per module.
capabilityRows.Risk: Teams may duplicate cross-module UI patterns.
capabilityRows.Recommendation: Adopt one module shell template and central workbench components.

capabilityRows.Backend Capability: Spring MVC controllers and capabilities endpoints
capabilityRows.Frontend Impact: Can discover operations and expose module actions.
capabilityRows.Risk: Command routes may lack rich list/detail semantics for some use cases.
capabilityRows.Recommendation: Use generic workbench APIs for list/detail/search and command aliases for actions.

capabilityRows.Frontend Impact: Enables resource lists/detail/search for all JPA-backed resources.
capabilityRows.Risk: Generic records may not provide business-friendly display fields.
capabilityRows.Recommendation: Create frontend column metadata adapters and request backend display metadata later if needed.

capabilityRows.Frontend Impact: Can drive menu/route/action guards from backend route metadata.
capabilityRows.Risk: Catalog is metadata-only; no route-specific @PreAuthorize evidence.
capabilityRows.Recommendation: Treat permissions as display/guard contract, not as proof of backend enforcement.

capabilityRows.Frontend Impact: Leaflet map can render layers, search and popups.
capabilityRows.Risk: Pipeline systems and pipelines are not explicit layers unless backend adds them.
capabilityRows.Recommendation: Visualize pipeline segments now; request explicit pipeline-systems and pipelines layers for enterprise GIS grouping.

capabilityRows.Frontend Impact: Use bearer tokens and role/scope claims.
capabilityRows.Risk: No local login or refresh endpoint.
capabilityRows.Recommendation: Integrate with enterprise IdP; do not invent HidraAPI login API.

capabilityRows.Frontend Impact: Standard error contract can support toast/dialog/form mapping.
capabilityRows.Recommendation: Central Axios error normalizer around ProblemDetail fields.

capabilityRows.Backend Capability: Async notification push and realtime SSE/STOMP
capabilityRows.Risk: Provider push gateway is local placeholder.
capabilityRows.Recommendation: Separate UI notification center from provider delivery semantics.
